remarks: Welcome to 21 Seir Hill Road, located in the highly desirable Silvermine neighborhood on the Norwalk/Wilton border. This beautifully designed 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom unit offers the perfect blend of comfort, privacy, and upscale living-it truly feels like a home, not an apartment. 2 Spacious Bedrooms 2 Full Bathrooms, including a stunning primary bath with a shower stall and a luxurious 6-foot whirlpool tub-perfect for unwinding after a long day. Gourmet Kitchen Enjoy custom cabinetry, high-end stainless steel appliances, and elegant granite countertops-ideal for everyday cooking or entertaining. Gas Fireplace Relax in the cozy living room and flip a switch to enjoy the ambiance of your gas fireplace, or step outside to your private patio through sliding glass doors. Real Hardwood Floors run throughout the unit, adding warmth and sophistication to every room. Prime Location Nestled in scenic Silvermine, you're just minutes from Wilton and Downtown Norwalk, with easy access to shopping, dining, and transportation.
